progress.command: cd /tmp && rm -rf pk && mkdir pk && cd pk && for p in pi-coding-agent pi-durable pi-codemode pi-tui pi-ai chord; do npm pack @earendil-works/$p@1.6.0 --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; done; for f in *.tgz; do mkdir -p "${f%.tgz}"; tar xzf "$f" -C "${f%.tgz}"; done; ls; for d in */; do echo "== $d"; ls $d/package; done; npm view @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.6.0 dependencies peerDependencies --json; npm view typescript@7.0.2 main exports bin --json | head -40
